title: Diagram bundle upload (diagram.bundle/v1)
description: The JSON document the GitHub Action sends to a control plane's ingest endpoint (gzip-compressed, at most 2 MB on the wire): the files of the evidence bundle it wrote to _diagram/, with the model file's path and the commit the workflow ran on. The entries are the bundle's own files (receipt.json, model.json, explanation.txt, receipt.json.sig and signing-key.pem when signed, and the generated files as plan/<name>); the receiver re-checks them (the receipt's schema, the content hash recomputed from the model and plan, the signatures) rather than trusting anything here.

model_path.description: The model file's path in the repository, with forward slashes, as the Action's `model` input names it (relative to the workspace).

sha.description: The commit the workflow ran on, as the Action read it from GITHUB_SHA. A client's claim, left out when the environment does not hold a hexadecimal commit id.

entries.description: The bundle's files. Names are unique and relative to the bundle.

content.description: The file's text, byte for byte.
